archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Silent Hill: Townfall Reframes Horror in First Person

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Sets a Limited Los Angeles Hands-On Event for September 30
entries.summary: Xbox will hold a one-night Gears of War: E-Day takeover at Hollywood & Vine in Los Angeles on September 30, offering an early hands-on session, themed refreshments, and giveaways. Entry is first come, first served for guests aged 18 or older and capped at 500 people.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire announcement specifies the date, location, access rules, age requirement, and attendance cap.
entries.timeNote: The source was published at 9:00 PM Beijing time on September 21; the event date is September 30 in Los Angeles.

entries.headline: Silent Hill: Townfall Reframes the Series’ Horror Through a First-Person View
entries.summary: A PlayStation Blog feature details how Silent Hill: Townfall uses protagonist Simon Ordell’s restricted viewpoint and a 2.35:1 frame to heighten tension. Its handheld CRTV can reveal nearby enemies, while DualSense haptics signal new threats.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog feature directly describes the perspective, protagonist, CRTV, and DualSense feedback.
entries.timeNote: The source was published at 3:00 PM Beijing time on September 21.

entries.headline: Fish & Ships Announced as a Six-Player Co-op Airship Adventure
entries.summary: DoubleMoose Games has announced Fish & Ships, a cooperative action-adventure in which two to six players divide duties such as steering, handling sails, making repairs, and fueling an airship while crossing floating islands in search of the sea. It is planned for PC via Steam.
entries.verification: Two independent opened reports from AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer corroborate the announcement, player count, core premise, and platform.
entries.timeNote: Both reports were published on September 21 Beijing time; the packet does not provide an official announcement time.
